prompt: As we are facing more and more problems which affect the whole planet, good relationships between different countries are becoming more important than ever before. To what extent do you agree or disagree?
essay:
As many modern problems affect countries across the world, good international relationships have become increasingly important. I strongly agree with this view because global challenges require cooperation between nations, while strong international ties also encourage economic and technological exchange.

On the one hand, good relationships between countries are essential because many modern problems cannot be solved by individual nations. Climate change, pandemics and environmental pollution often cross national borders, meaning that actions taken by one country can affect others. For example, reducing greenhouse-gas emissions requires nations to agree on common targets and share information about effective environmental measures. Similarly, during a global health crisis, countries need to exchange medical knowledge and cooperate on disease control. Without such cooperation, efforts made by individual governments may have limited effects. Therefore, strong international relationships are essential for addressing problems that affect the whole planet.

Another important benefit of strong international relationships is greater economic and technological cooperation. Countries can trade with one another and share knowledge, skills and technological developments. For instance, developing nations can gain access to advanced technologies and professional expertise from more developed economies, while businesses can enter international markets and create new opportunities. This exchange can contribute to economic growth and technological innovation. Although countries naturally have different interests, maintaining constructive relationships makes it easier to negotiate disagreements and cooperate when common interests are involved. For this reason, international ties are valuable not only for solving global problems but also for supporting development.

In conclusion, I strongly agree that good relationships between countries are more important than ever. International cooperation is necessary to address global problems, while trade and the exchange of knowledge and technology can also support economic and social development.
